description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPTestConnectionAPI class, which is an API endpoint for testing LDAP connections within the OrangeHRM system. It handles request validation, LDAP configuration, testing LDAP authentication, and reporting connection and user lookup statuses.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoint for testing LDAP connection, handling request validation, communication with LDAP services, and returning the test results including authentication and user lookup statuses.

methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPTestSyncService with the given LDAP settings.

methods.description: Performs the LDAP connection test, retrieves user entries, handles exceptions, and compiles a status report including authentication and user lookup results.
